sheets.name: Read Me
rows: Accommodation demand capture database – built 19 Oct 2026.

Captures the property each potential partner needs (where, what type, how many, on what terms), tracks properties offered against each requirement, and shows the shortfall. Feeds the Buy Box (brief s.11).
Opp ID and evidence codes (E-numbers) refer to Laurito_Regional_Opportunities_Database_v2.xlsx. Add new partners there first, then capture their requirements here.

One row per partner × area × property type. Grey columns are formulas: units matched, shortfall, LHA benchmark, rent vs LHA, 'defined demand complete' (area, type, units and timing all stated – the brief's G7 test) and the dashboard rank key.
Log each property considered; pick the Req ID from the drop-down. Fit check compares type and bedrooms with the requirement. 'Approved by partner' and 'Leased / let' units count as matched.
Each partner's stated landlord package, with the date it was given.
Discovery-call checklist based on the brief's BD information request (A9).

UC monthly LHA rates for April 2026–March 2027 (frozen at April 2024 levels) for Central Greater Manchester, Bristol, Gloucester and Cheltenham BRMAs. Gloucestershire rows use the Gloucester BRMA unless the area mentions Cheltenham. Added 19 Oct 2026; Cheltenham and GM shared-room rates are from a secondary compilation – verify on LHA-Direct.

34 requirement rows: 18 from evidence (Nacro, Mears, Serco, MCC, Centennial, Bristol CC) and 16 'To capture' rows for priority partners with no stated requirement yet. Review dates set by priority (High 30 Oct, Medium 27 Nov 2026, Low 29 Jan 2027) – proposed, adjust as needed.

Blank = not stated by the partner. Do not infer. Serco 2024 matrix and Mears Dec 2024 request are marked 'Historic – verify'. Rent vs LHA below 90% is highlighted red (brief gate G1 uses ≥90% of OMR – LHA is only a proxy).
